activationRule: All existing partner policy ids, activation mappings, signed schemas and profiles remain pinned. No partner is newly activated and no running consumer is automatically upgraded to SDK 0.3.0. A change to an existing pinned integration or poller contract still requires that partner's own new policy and explicit promotion. This matrix records local code, fixture and contract checks only; it is not a partner sign-off or new live partner acceptance.
